description: Trafic routier - Points de comptage temporaires - Département du Loiret - 2015 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Geolocation of temporary road counting points accompanied by annual traffic indicators (all-vehicle TMJA / percentage share of heavy-duty vehicles / TMJA heavy-duty vehicles) - 2015 edition. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Road traffic - Temporary counting points - Department of Loiret - 2015" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include 2015, Mobilité, Données ouvertes, Route, Points de comptage. The listing shows 2022-04-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
